name: Jon Micheel
career_history: Associate Director at Turner & Townsend, 3/2026 to present; Senior Project Manager at Turner & Townsend, 1/2025 to present; Senior Project Manager at JLL, 6/2017 to 10/2017; Project Manager at JLL, 3/2014 to 6/2017; Associate Project Manager at JLL, 12/2012 to 3/2014

biography:
I am a Senior Project Manager for Turner & Townsend in the Denver, Colorado area. I am known for my client-focused mentality. In a strategic manner, I lead clients through the process of mapping their needs to the development of an ideal construction plan. My top priority is to bring a high level of integrity and quality to each project. 

Recently I have managed projects for a wide range of clients, including Bain & Co., Snell & Wilmer, TriTower Financial, Beckman Coulter, Salesforce, CableLabs, Guaranty Bank, Envision Healthcare, Level 3 Communications, ProBuild, Vertafore, The City of Englewood, Marketo, William Lyon Homes and Boston Market. These projects ranged in scope from interior office tenant finish to life science, design/build ground-up light manufacturing facilities and new ground up civic police facilities. I have extensive knowledge in contract management, change management, design interface, schedule management and constructability. 

I have 19 plus years of project management and construction experience. I have worked as a project manager / estimator for a general contractor where I ran a wide range of projects that included high-end office tenant improvements, data centers, satellite uplink facilities, a television station studio, and numerous design/build projects. Prior to my current role as a Senior Project Manager at Turner & Townsend/CBRE, I worked as a superintendent on multifamily housing projects, as a Project Engineer on hospitality and multifamily projects along with my last career role as a Senior Project Manager at JLL.

The benefit of my broad construction and operations is expertise in conceptual budgeting, the design/build process, estimating, scheduling and team oversight.
